It allows creators to automate their order fulfillment process, ensuring that payments through cryptocurrencies result in immediate product delivery.
What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Google apps

Google Apps Script is a powerful tool that enables automation of tasks across various Google services. For digital commerce, it can streamline the entire process from payment confirmation to product delivery. By utilizing Google Apps Script, creators can craft workflows that automatically manage orders, ensuring that customers receive their digital products without delay. This is critical in regions where traditional payment processors are unavailable, allowing creators to maintain a seamless buying experience for their customers.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

At the core of this infrastructure is the webhook system that triggers once a cryptocurrency payment is confirmed through NOWPayments. Google Apps Script listens for these webhooks and processes orders in under 30 seconds. It communicates with Google Sheets or Supabase for order storage and can automatically send emails via Gmail or Resend to deliver download links. This architecture is designed to be reliable and efficient, ensuring that creators can operate their stores without manual intervention.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This automation framework is designed for digital creators who need a dependable solution to sell their products online. Creators in countries with limited access to conventional payment systems can leverage Google Apps Script to take control of their sales process. By utilizing this infrastructure, they no longer rely on external platforms that may impose restrictions or high fees. Instead, they harness the power of automation to deliver value directly to their customers.
Harness automation to eliminate manual order fulfillment.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The effective deployment of this system relies on several key components: Cloudflare Workers for processing webhook events, Google Apps Script for automating tasks, and NOWPayments for cryptocurrency transactions. Together, these tools create a cohesive ecosystem. When a customer makes a purchase, the webhook triggers Google Apps Script, which then updates the order status in Supabase or Google Sheets and sends the download link via email. This integration ensures a smooth and efficient order fulfillment process.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To implement this solution, start by setting up your Cloudflare Workers to handle webhooks from NOWPayments. Then, create a Google Apps Script that listens for these webhooks and processes orders accordingly. Next, establish a database using Supabase or Google Sheets to store order details. Finally, configure your email service to send download links upon payment confirmation. This structured approach will enable you to automate your digital commerce effectively.
How does automated digital product delivery work with crypto payments?

Automated digital product delivery works by using webhooks to trigger actions once a crypto payment is confirmed. When a customer completes a transaction, the NOWPayments webhook sends a notification to your Google Apps Script, which processes the order and sends the download link to the customer automatically. This ensures instant fulfillment and customer satisfaction.
Ensure instant product delivery with every successful crypto payment.

The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents the complete technical implementation for both Stack 01 and Stack 02. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Deploy your backend first — Cloudflare Worker or Google Apps Script Web App — and confirm the endpoint URL is accessible via HTTP POST before configuring NOWPayments. Set the IPN webhook URL in your NOWPayments account settings to point to your backend endpoint. Set the IPN secret key in both NOWPayments and your backend configuration — this is the string that both sides use to verify webhook authenticity. Upload your product files to the configured delivery storage — Cloudflare R2 or Google Drive — with the paths matching your backend configuration. Complete a real mainnet transaction and check your backend logs to confirm the webhook was received, the signature was validated, the transaction was verified on-chain, the order was logged, and the delivery email was sent. Monitor the order database daily for the first week.
Frequently Asked Questions
How does automated digital product delivery work with crypto payments?

Automated digital product delivery leverages webhooks from payment processors like NOWPayments. Once a payment is confirmed, a webhook triggers your Google Apps Script, which processes the order and sends the product link to the buyer instantly.
What is a webhook and how does it trigger order fulfillment?

A webhook is a mechanism that allows one system to send real-time data to another. In this setup, when a crypto payment is completed, NOWPayments sends a webhook to your Google Apps Script, initiating the order fulfillment process automatically.
Can I automatically send download links after a crypto payment confirms?

Yes, you can automatically send download links. By configuring your Google Apps Script to react to payment confirmations via webhooks, you can ensure that customers receive their product links immediately after a successful transaction.
What tools do I need to set this up?

You'll need Cloudflare Workers for handling webhooks, Google Apps Script for automation, and a database like Supabase or Google Sheets to store order details. Additionally, configure an email service to send product delivery links.
How quickly can I expect orders to be processed?

With a correctly configured sovereign stack, orders can be processed in under 30 seconds. This rapid processing ensures that customers receive their digital products promptly after payment confirmation.
